mapper.select: select count(*) from ( SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, sr.status_id AS reservationStatusId, p.performance_title AS performanceTitle, p.performance_end_date AS performanceEndDate, r.reservation_code AS reservationCode, r.reservation_price AS reservationPrice, c.contract_charge AS contractCharge FROM reservation r JOIN performance p ON r.performance_id = p.performance_id JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id JOIN contract c ON m.member_id = c.member_id AND c.contract_effective_from <= #{now} AND (c.contract_effective_to IS NULL OR c.contract_effective_to >= #{now}) JOIN status sr ON r.status_id = sr.status_id JOIN status sp ON p.status_id = sp.status_id WHERE (CASE WHEN r.reservation_updated_at IS NULL THEN r.reservation_created_at ELSE r.reservation_updated_at END) > ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(settlement_detail_created_at), '1970-01-01'::TIMESTAMPTZ) FROM settlement_detail ) AND #{now} BETWEEN p.performance_start_date AND p.performance_end_date AND sr.status_id IN (9, 10) AND sp.status_id = 1 );

SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, sr.status_id AS reservationStatusId, p.performance_title AS performanceTitle, p.performance_end_date AS performanceEndDate, r.reservation_code AS reservationCode, r.reservation_price AS reservationPrice, c.contract_charge AS contractCharge, #{now} AS settlementDetailCreatedAt FROM reservation r JOIN performance p ON r.performance_id = p.performance_id JOIN member m ON p.member_id = m.member_id JOIN contract c ON m.member_id = c.member_id AND c.contract_effective_from <= #{now} AND (c.contract_effective_to IS NULL OR c.contract_effective_to >= #{now}) JOIN status sr ON r.status_id = sr.status_id JOIN status sp ON p.status_id = sp.status_id WHERE COALESCE(r.reservation_updated_at, r.reservation_created_at) > #{lastTimeSeconds} AND #{now}::TIMESTAMPTZ - INTERVAL '1 min' BETWEEN p.performance_start_date AND p.performance_end_date AND sr.status_id IN (9, 10) AND sp.status_id = 1 ORDER BY r.reservation_id LIMIT #{_pagesize} OFFSET #{_skiprows}

( #{detail.member.id}, #{detail.status.id}, #{detail.performanceTitle}, #{detail.performanceEndDate}, #{detail.reservationCode}, #{detail.salesAmount}, #{detail.refundAmount}, #{detail.grossAmount}, #{detail.contractCharge}, #{detail.commission}, #{detail.netAmount}, #{detail.createdAt} )
